title: Twin Cast: Your Career Isn’t Temporary
description:
On the Twin Cast podcast, the Twins talk about a mindset shift every young adult needs — your career is not temporary.

It’s not something you just “try for now” and figure out later. The decisions you make early on shape your income, your lifestyle, and your future.

That’s why having direction matters. When you choose a path, you need to be ready to commit, grow, and put in the work over time.

Success doesn’t come from guessing — it comes from being intentional.

Follow for more Twin Cast conversations, career advice, and real-life lessons.
